details: Synergy Labs Mars Explorer is an interactive web application designed to simulate and explore the Martian surface. It features 2D and 3D viewing modes, street view capabilities, a route planner, a field guide, and an integrated AI assistant. Users can examine major landmarks like the Valles Marineris canyon system alongside estimated environmental conditions, including temperature, air pressure, radiation, and dust opacity. The interface also displays Martian local solar time, terrain hazard assessments, and allows users to report hazards. Note that the platform explicitly states its terrain geometry and safety ratings are illustrative sample data rather than certified navigation metrics.
